key_insight: SUMNO turns a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, achieving strong fluid-flow prediction accuracy with 9.4 million parameters.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a compact surrogate approach for accelerating regular-grid CFD predictions across steady and unsteady flows.
method: Use parameter-free downsampling and upsampling for restriction and prolongation, with additive skips for coarse-grid correction.
Keep transfer and skip pathways normalization-free.
Combine fine- and intermediate-scale convolutions with coarse-scale shifted-window attention supporting periodicity independently per axis.
evidence_signal: Across four benchmarks and five baselines on unseen test configurations, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, reducing 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% versus the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The method targets regular grids; applicability to unstructured meshes and stability beyond the reported rollout horizon remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
